authority: Explicit user instruction superseding the earlier service-engineering eligibility rule.
scope: Every current company and startup listing, including historical imports and pending proposals.

companyAndStartup.required: Primary-source evidence that the organisation demonstrably develops or produces relevant technology of its own, with a supported local presence.
companyAndStartup.evidence: Identify the organisation's own relevant product, platform, hardware, technical research or maintained technology and evidence of its development or production. A customer implementation or use of third-party tools alone is insufficient. Own technology need not be closed-source or patented.
companyAndStartup.uncertainty: Missing evidence, unavailable pages and service-oriented names alone do not prove ineligibility. Record uncertain and investigate; never blanket-delete on those grounds.
companyAndStartup.developmentThreshold: Concrete maintained original software, platforms, hardware, formulations, research or technical processes suffice, including technology built on open source or developed with partners. No patents, exclusive IP paperwork, internal-only engineering, standalone commercial product or multiple-customer sales are required. Identify substantive technology attributable to the organisation rather than crediting upstream vendors or unrelated customer/sister-company products. Ordinary support, resale and generic client-only implementation remain excluded under the user criterion.

separateCategories: Preserve approved investor, university, research and technical nonprofit/ecosystem criteria. Investor topics describe explicit investment mandates; investors are not required to produce proprietary products.

actions.pendingServices: Stop pending service imports until reassessed against this version.
actions.wittwer-it-services: User specifically authorised removal of the map location using the supported location removal path, preserving the organisation and relationships.
actions.otherExclusions: Prepare exact public-location-only removals for main review; do not execute without approval.
actions.preservation: Never delete organisations, profiles, links, memberships, sponsors, addresses or other relationships as part of this sweep.

activeStatus.quietStartups: A young or quiet startup is not inactive merely because LinkedIn activity, hiring or recent announcements are sparse. Do not impose a minimum social-posting cadence.
activeStatus.investigation: Investigate multiple independent dormancy signals such as a ceased product, abandoned official website, explicit closure, registry dissolution or a successor identity. A failed page retrieval or old news date alone is insufficient.
activeStatus.identity: Verify dissolved entities against authoritative register evidence and acquired entities against official acquisition and current operating-brand evidence. Acquisition alone does not imply that technology development or the local team has ceased.
activeStatus.uncertainty: Record unresolved activity or identity questions explicitly; do not remove map locations solely for missing evidence. Keep activity and own-technology eligibility as separate assessments.

finalReview: Mandatory high-signal review before closeout: reconcile the current population and newly added rows, challenge all exclusion proposals and ambiguous keeps against primary evidence, check acquired/dissolved identities, verify exact public location IDs and preserve records/relationships. Report reviewed and unreviewed counts; never describe initial retrieval as completed semantic review.
coverage: Count all company/startup rows separately from completed primary-source reviews. Unreviewed is not equivalent to keep or exclude.
specialisedFacilities: Specialised physical testing/research infrastructure can qualify as Lab without a proprietary commercial product; EMVLAB EMC/radio testing is explicitly approved. This exception does not include ordinary IT support or generic client consultancy. Commercial producers such as Passam may be better classified as Company.
